correction: Publication of the archive, multiple parts and completion is not one cross-file atomic operation. If later publication, fsync or completion writing fails, some final-named archive/part files may remain. There is no success credit unless an authoritative successful export job and the hash-pinned COMPLETE_WITH_REFERENCED_PARENT marker exist, and the entire two-package byte closure verifies. Final filenames alone do not establish completion.
review_origin: Independent PQ review of exact ce96 exporter and original multi-file publication protocol.
revised_statement: Failure awards no successful completion; it may leave staging files and/or some final-named published files. All such bytes remain incomplete until the explicit consumer contract is satisfied.
supersedes_design_sentence: failure leaves only owned staging artifacts and no successful completion
